description: New cloud identity was created and assigned administrative policy.
investigative_actions: Confirm whether this activity was intentional. Check for other API calls that were executed by the identity. Look for any suspicious behavior from the IAM user/role to whom the administrative policy was attached.
name: New cloud identity created with administrative policy
